summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric multiplayer action RPG in a shared playable realm, with a solo Veil title/menu place. Place and actor scripts run quests, combat, bosses, services and ambience; shared Bearer/data modules support persistence and progression, while authored cells and seeded generators build the regions. Main cells now include wandering wisps in Lanternmere and the Vale, mixed and repositioned tree cover, and clearer walk/fight spaces through the road, Abbey approach, Orchard, Vale and Hollow Deep.
places: places/main/ - shared realm: seven cells hold Lanternmere, Broken Lantern Road, Abbey, Hanging Orchard, Frostbitten Vale, Ossuary and Hollow Deep; sim.js runs quests, packs and bosses.
places/veil/ - solo title/menu realm; its sim rotates menu music while menu-open Bearers are routed here.
roots: world.config.yaml, templates/player.js, templates/camera.js - world entry/config attaches the player and camera and maps actions.
places/main/cells/ - authored realm terrain, static dressing, flora, lights and actor placements; scene transforms/parameters seed generated props.
scripts/places/main/sim.js, scripts/places/veil/sim.js - place-level spawn/quest/combat orchestration and menu ambience.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema and character roster/create/load/save/remove; persistent state shared by menu and player flows.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - registered bodies and height metadata used by player, enemy spawning and effects.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - chapter/floor distance rules used by player movement and progression gates.
scripts/lib/data/flora*.js, scripts/lib/data/fauna.js - biome flora and species data reused by scene dressing and wildlife behavior.
scripts/gen/vf-kit.js, fen-kit.js, hub-kit.js, orch-kit.js - shared construction helpers used by their corresponding regional generators.
scripts/gen/zone-floor.js, scripts/gen/bw-floor.js - seeded non-colliding ground cover generators reused by authored cell rows.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, sigLand, meleeLand, boltLand, crosswoundFall, burnTick, update.
scripts/ui.js - default state-driven HUD, menu and sheets, talent tree, unit frames, enemy labels/portraits and version notes.
scripts/places/veil/sim.js - cadence, tick; menu music rotation.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; ordinary/mini-boss enemy runtime helpers.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, roster, create/load/save/remove.
scripts/gen/zone-floor.js and scripts/gen/bw-floor.js - generated geometry and collider interfaces.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer combat/progression, quest/reward claims, inventory/gear, arts, shrines, vault and talents; packed position/zone inform re-entry.
scripts/player.js - active-body movement, combat, death, class skills/timers, menu/options scratch, floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats.
places/main/sim.js - quest/dialog/cut progress and claims, NPC/service and enemy spawning, boss lifecycle/reset, respawn rows and place mood/music state.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary/mini-boss enemy AI, hp/casts/death, movement effects, summons and eligible Bearer payouts/drops.
scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js, abbess.js - respective boss health, phases, casts/adds, defeat and participant/place boss rows.
scripts/fauna.js, forest-wisp.js, greeter.js - per-actor wildlife/wisp motion and townsfolk dialogue bubble/cooldown state.
places/main/cells/ - authored environmental placement owns transforms, seeds, species/model choices, light settings and scene-static colliders.
flows: world.config.yaml → templates/player.js attaches player and maps actions; ui.js menu actions → player.js title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options/notes routing.
defaultPlace veil → player menu; player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realm configuration hydrates Bearer fields and menu-open Bearers move to veil.
world controls and controls.js select world/menu touch surfaces; ui.js actions → player.js and service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS and packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player quest/cut/boss flags and service interactions → places/main/sim.js quest progression, realm progression and claim state.
main sim PACKS + combat profiles + models.js body/HEIGHT → enemySpec spawns wax-pack actors; wax-pack runs combat, respawn and eligible payouts/drops.
main sim PACKS → region enemy families and bosses; profile summon rows → wax-pack mini-boss adds.
Bearer cls → player.js selects models.js body and class attacks; cast/impact handlers emit FX, including rune rings, primalist claw scores and Hellwarden ember-crush effects.
Scene fauna rows tagged fauna + fauna data → scripts/fauna.js wildlife; scene forest-wisp rows + home/r/seed → scripts/forest-wisp.js motion and startled presentation.
Candlehold town-* scene rows name/title/lines and bubble child → greeter.js rotating flavor dialogue; not service or quest routing.
Cell floor rows pass origin, bounds/clear circles, biome/zone, count and seed → bw-floor.js or zone-floor.js non-colliding cover; scene flora/tree rows carry the authored clear-space placement.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and transform; share hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js and vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks, clutter, road/arena/approach and Abbey forms vary by params/dimensions/seed; most share vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/fen-*.js - Lanternmere terrain dressing, path, waystones, trees/props and heart structures are seeded regional generators; share fen-kit.js where applicable.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js with cap-gate.js, cap-house.js and cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate share local-frame helpers; dimensions, light and seed vary by instance.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing shares shapes.js and wax palette.
scripts/gen/orch-*.js - seeded Hanging Orchard gallows, gibbets and props share orch-kit.js; cells also place swaying apple GLBs and floor cover.
scripts/gen/zone-floor.js - biome-aware seeded plants/debris vary by kind, zone, terrain height, bounds and clearings; supports fen, ash-road/Abbey and other regional floor dressing.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural wax-figure generator; current wax actors use registered models.js bodies.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; talents, shrines, vault and vaultRows persist per Bearer, while proximity flags and vault UI reads are transient.

Talent IDs are branch-tier strings b-t across six tiers; each earlier tier requires 3 points per tier in that branch, and t=5 is a single-rank capstone worth five times its stat; class keystones drive calling-specific behavior.
Wayshrine IDs/coordinates in combat.yml must stay aligned with scene IDs/locations; travel costs 10 copper, refuses with an enemy within 10 m, and Abbey obeys the player gate.
Personal vault is 18 slots plus up to three purchased rows of nine; guild vault is 27 shared slots per Spawn guild per realm in SQL, separate from character inventory.
Enemy kinds must stay aligned across main sim PACKS, combat.yml, models.js MODELS/HEIGHT, loot/economy data, wax-pack.js and ui.js labels/portraits; HEIGHT is metres.

Scene floor rows pass generator world origin plus local bounds/clear circles and zone filters; generated floor cover has no collider. Fern sway depends on geometry uv().y (heart-to-tip) and uv().x (leaflet shade).
